arxiv-1906-10360.title: A lower bound for the void coalescence load in nonlinearly elastic solids
arxiv-1906-10360.creator: Victor Cañulef-Aguilar
arxiv-1906-10360.description: Abstract The problem of the sudden growth and coalescence of voids in elastic media is considered. The Dirichlet energy is minimized among incompressible and invertible Sobolev deformations of a two-dimensional domain having n n microvoids of radius ε \varepsilon .

arxiv-2206-12870.title: Experimental construction of a symmetric three-qubit entangled state and its utility in testing the violation of a Bell inequality on an NMR quantum simulator
arxiv-2206-12870.creator: Dileep Singh, Vaishali Gulati, Arvind, Kavita Dorai
arxiv-2206-12870.description: Abstract We designed a quantum circuit to prepare a permutation-symmetric maximally entangled three-qubit state called the | S ⟩ |{\rm S}\rangle state and experimentally created it on an NMR quantum processor. The presence of entanglement in the state was certified by computing two different entanglement measures, namely negativity and concurrence.

arxiv-2301-06064.title: Symbolic expression generation via Variational Auto-Encoder
arxiv-2301-06064.creator: Sergei Popov, Mikhail Lazarev, Vladislav Belavin, Denis Derkach, Andrey Ustyuzhanin
arxiv-2301-06064.description: Abstract There are many problems in physics, biology, and other natural sciences in which symbolic regression can provide valuable insights and discover new laws of nature. A widespread Deep Neural Networks do not provide interpretable solutions. Meanwhile, symbolic expressions give us a clear relation between observations and the target variable.

arxiv-2307-04851.title: Physics-Based Modeling and Validation of 2D Schottky Barrier Field-Effect Transistors
arxiv-2307-04851.creator: Ashwin Tunga a , Zijing Zhao, Ankit Shukla, Wenjuan Zhu, and Shaloo Rakheja
arxiv-2307-04851.description: Abstract In this work, we describe the charge transport in two-dimensional (2D) Schottky barrier field-effect transistors (SB-FETs) based on the carrier injection at the Schottky contacts. We first develop a numerical model for thermionic and field-emission processes of carrier injection that occur at a Schottky contact.

arxiv-2311-16831.title: Polarized Online Discourse on Abortion: Frames and Hostile Expressions among Liberals and Conservatives
arxiv-2311-16831.creator: Ashwin Rao, Rong-Ching Chang, Qiankun Zhong, Kristina Lerman, Magdalena Wojcieszak
arxiv-2311-16831.description: Abstract Abortion has been one of the most divisive issues in the United States. Yet, missing is comprehensive longitudinal evidence on how political divides on abortion are reflected in public discourse over time, on a national scale, and in response to key events before and after the overturn of Roe v Wade. We analyze a corpus of over 3.

arxiv-2403-04845.title: Catalytic transformations for thermal operations
arxiv-2403-04845.creator: Jakub Czartowski, A. de Oliveira Junior
arxiv-2403-04845.description: Abstract What are the fundamental limits and advantages of using a catalyst to aid thermodynamic transformations between quantum systems? In this work, we answer this question by focusing on transformations between energy-incoherent states under the most general energy-conserving interactions among the system, the catalyst, and a thermal environment.

arxiv-2405-05109.title: QFMTS : Generating Query-Focused Summaries over Multi-Table Inputs
arxiv-2405-05109.creator: Weijia Zhang, Vaishali Pal, Jia-Hong Huang, Evangelos Kanoulas, Maarten de Rijke
arxiv-2405-05109.description: Abstract Table summarization is a crucial task aimed at condensing information from tabular data into concise and comprehensible textual summaries. However, existing approaches often fall short of adequately meeting users’ information and quality requirements and tend to overlook the complexities of real-world queries. In this paper, we propose a novel method to address these limitations by introducing query-focused multi-table summarization.

arxiv-2504-04832.title: Pullback and Weil transfer on Chow groups Thanks: This work has been done during the second named author’s stay at the Institut des Hautes Etudes Scientifiques.
arxiv-2504-04832.creator: Nikita Karpenko, Guangzhao Zhu
arxiv-2504-04832.description: Abstract . In the paper “Weil transfer of algebraic cycles”, published by the second author in Indagationes Mathematicae about 25 years ago, a Weil transfer map for Chow groups of smooth algebraic varieties has been constructed and its basic properties have been established.

arxiv-2602-16117.title: Solving BDNK diffusion using physics-informed neural networks
arxiv-2602-16117.creator: Vicente Chomalí-Castro, Nick Clarisse, Nicki Mullins, Jorge Noronha
arxiv-2602-16117.description: Abstract In this work, we reformulate the relativistic BDNK (Bemfica-Disconzi-Noronha-Kovtun) diffusion equation in flux-conservative form, and solve the resulting equations in ( 1 + 1 ) (1+1) D using both a second-order Kurganov-Tadmor finite volume scheme and physics-informed neural networks (PINNs).

pmc-10716400.title: Fine-grained interplanetary dust input during the Turonian (Late Cretaceous): evidence from osmium isotope and platinum group elements
pmc-10716400.creator: Hironao Matsumoto, Akira Ishikawa, Rodolfo Coccioni, Fabrizio Frontalini, Katsuhiko Suzuki
pmc-10716400.description: The Turonian age (~ 90–94 Ma) was the hottest geological interval in the Cretaceous and also marked by the K3 event, a pronounced enrichment of 3He in pelagic sediments (i.e., massive input of extraterrestrial materials). Here, we present Os isotopic (187Os/188Os) and platinum group element (PGE) data from Turonian sedimentary records.

pmc-10720540.title: Research Ready: a student-initiated workshop model for developing foundational research skills
pmc-10720540.creator: Nivetha Sivarajah, Jenevan A. Irranious, Sivagini Krishnamoorthy, Thayaparan Kalaineethan, Deluxeani Kugathasan, Uventhikka Sivanantham, Mary E. McMillan, Natkunam Ketheesan
pmc-10720540.description: Travel restrictions, pandemics, economic downturn, and increasing costs in organizing workshops all impact on face-to-face training of undergraduates planning to undertake research. The inability to obtain basic, first-hand information regarding research in practice causes undue stress for students and leads to unrealistic expectations regarding research projects.

pmc-11389269.title: Ferroptosis in radiation-induced brain injury: roles and clinical implications
pmc-11389269.creator: Lifang Li, Xia Liu, Chunfeng Han, Licheng Tian, Yongzhi Wang, Baolin Han
pmc-11389269.description: Radiation-induced brain injury (RBI) presents a significant challenge for patients undergoing radiation therapy for head, neck, and intracranial tumors. This review aims to elucidate the role of ferroptosis in RBI and its therapeutic implications. Specifically, we explore how ferroptosis can enhance the sensitivity of tumor cells to radiation while also examining strategies to mitigate radiation-induced damage to normal brain tissues.

pmc-13098761.title: Emergence of outbreak-driving high-risk Pseudomonas aeruginosa lineages in Taiwan: phylogenomic insights into ST292 and the ST235* sublineage
pmc-13098761.creator: Chih-Ming Chen, Hui-Ling Tang, Se-Chin Ke, Yi-Pei Lin, Bo-Han Chen, Ru-Hsiou Teng, Chien-Shun Chiou, Min-Chi Lu, Yi-Chyi Lai
pmc-13098761.description: The global rise of carbapenem-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa (CRPA) poses a significant threat to public health. Through active surveillance conducted between 2021 and 2022, we collected 92 distinct CRPA isolates and identified a clonal shift toward high-risk lineages ST235* and ST292.

pmc-13115527.title: Dysregulation of Aurora Kinases and AURKAIP1 Promoter Methylation as Potential Peripheral Diagnostic Biomarkers in Acute Myeloid Leukemia
pmc-13115527.creator: Zubeyde Yalniz Kayim, Seref Bugra Tuncer, Betul Celik Demirbas, Ugur Gezer, Ozge Sukruoglu Erdogan, Seda Kilic Erciyas, Nejat Dalay, Akif Selim Yavuz, Vildan Yasasever
pmc-13115527.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Acute myeloid leukemia (AML) is an aggressive hematologic malignancy characterized by impaired differentiation and accumulation of immature myeloid cells. Aurora kinases and their regulatory genes play key roles in mitotic progression and may contribute to leukemogenesis. This study aimed to evaluate the expression and promoter methylation status of AURKA, AURKB, and AURKC and their regulatory genes, AURKAIP1, E2F1, and E2F4 in AML.

pmc-13145148.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026OT103 EARLY INITIATED AMBULANCE-DELIVERED LEVETIRACETAM AND HEADPOSITION IN HYPER-ACUTE STROKE TRIAL (EAST): PROTOCOL AND UPDATE
pmc-13145148.creator: Chen Chen, Feifeng Liu, Yapeng Lin, Lili Song, Craig Anderson, Gang Li
pmc-13145148.description: Background and aimsCurrently, there’s no efficient treatment in the ambulance for undifferentiated stroke patients. pmc-13421743.title: An integrated peripheral immune circuit of inflammation and dysfunction underlies drug resistance in pediatric drug-resistant epilepsy
pmc-13421743.creator: Ting Zhao, Hong-jian Li, Hui-lan Zhang, Yan Sun, Lu-hai Yu, Jing Yu
pmc-13421743.description: BackgroundTo systematically investigate the dynamic changes in peripheral immune cell composition and function under different clinical phenotypes, detect important immune subpopulations and regulatory networks that cause drug-resistant epilepsy (DRE), and offer new theoretical and translational insights into immune classification, early intervention, and targeted therapy in pediatric DRE.

pmc-13477025.title: Compound delivery of eVLPs enhances prime editing for targeted genome engineering and high-throughput screening
pmc-13477025.creator: Jethro Langley, Lou Baudrier, Jada Curry, Kiran Narta, Hayley M Todesco, Kyle Potts, Sorana Morrissy, Douglas J Mahoney, Pierre Billon

pmc-13595549.title: Platelet concentrates integrated with tissue engineering scaffolds: a promising approach for wound healing application
pmc-13595549.creator: Yinglin Xu, Chunlei Dai, Jianlin Huang, Yiqun Wu, Liying Wang, Jun Wu
pmc-13595549.description: Wound healing is a complex process involving various factors and reconstruction of tissue structures. Platelets and their bioactive substances play an indispensable role in various stages of wound healing. Tissue engineering scaffolds are instrumental in maintaining, repairing, and enhancing tissue structure and function. Combining platelet concentrates with tissue engineering scaffolds heralds a novel direction for wound healing research.

uslaw-usc-t38-s7113.title: 38 U.S.C. § 7113 — Evidentiary record before the Board of Veterans’ Appeals
uslaw-usc-t38-s7113.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t38-s7113.description: United States Code, Title 38 (Veterans’ Benefits); Part V (Boards, Administrations, And Services); Chapter 71 (Board Of Veterans’ Appeals). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Cases With No Request for a Hearing or Additional Evidence.— For cases in which a hearing before the Board of Veterans’ Appeals is not requested in the notice of disagreement and no request was made to submit.
